title: Use OpenCode for Z.AI/GLM
content: Use a native OpenCode provider for Z.AI/GLM routing and retire the Claude-backed fake glm provider path.
rationale: Direct OpenCode execution honors exact Z.AI Coding Plan model selection including zai-coding-plan/glm-5.1, while the Claude-compatible shim collapsed model selection to glm-5-turbo despite explicit overrides. Provider semantics should reflect the actual execution harness instead of pretending GLM is a standalone Claude provider.
